name: The Shattered Hand
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Warchief is too subtle in his methods. He is cautious to unleash the might of the Horde. Once we were stronger, mighty conquerors all. That pride we must regain, and the Shattered Hand will do so.

We build strength from the shadows and strike at the exposed, secretly laying our enemies low. A task you must complete for me, to prove your worth.

The troll Tazan trades with the pirates near Ratchet. He has information I must have. Kill him and bring me his satchel.
narrative.objectives: Kill Tazan and bring his Satchel to Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hm, while I am glad to hear that Tazan is no longer with us, a locked satchel does us no good. We need the information kept within.

This should prove a worthy second challenge for one who wishes to join the Shattered Hand.
narrative.requestItemsText: It is a fool who believes a charge with axe drawn is more dangerous than a knife in the dark.
